name: Share sheet
summary: A share sheet shown open over a photo: recent people with their photos you can pick (picking one turns the bottom into a message and Send), apps as quiet round icon buttons, and a copy link row that confirms when the link is copied.
use: in a social or media app, when someone taps Share on a post
a11y: The sheet is a labelled modal dialog; recent people are native checkboxes in a fieldset, the apps are named buttons, and "Link copied" and "Sent" are announced in a status region.

use_when: sending a post, photo or listing straight to a few recent contacts with an optional message
avoid_when: inviting people to join a workspace with roles: use invite-members
a list of actions on an item, not sharing: use action-menu
a yes or no question in an overlay: use confirm-dialog

parts.name: backdrop
parts.what: the post behind the sheet, dimmed by a scrim; decorative

parts.name: people
parts.what: one recent person: photo and first name, a checkbox to pick them

parts.name: apps
parts.what: one place to share to: a round icon and a name

parts.name: copy
parts.what: copy link row with the link shown under it

parts.name: message
parts.what: a message field shown once someone is picked

parts.name: status
parts.what: a short status above the sheet: sent, copied or copy blocked

empty.how: the Smart UI renderer puts one plain 'Nothing to show yet.' line in an empty list

loading.how: the Smart UI renderer draws each marked slot as a quiet block of its size while the data arrives; the static file shows the filled part

error.how: if the browser blocks copying, the status line says to select the link and copy it by hand
error.evidence: Copying is blocked here: select the link and copy it

disabled.how: disable Send while sending and an app button when that app is not set up

overflow.how: the recent people row scrolls sideways in its own box, sized so a half person shows there is more
overflow.evidence: overflow-x: auto; scrollbar-width: none; overscroll-behavior-x: contain

long_text.how: person and app names are cut with an ellipsis; the link wraps at any character

missing_image.how: the Smart UI renderer swaps a photo that fails to load for a block of the same size with its alt text

keyboard: Tab reaches Close, Search, each recent person, each app, Copy link, then the message field and Send once someone is picked
Space on a person picks or unpicks them; picking anyone replaces the apps with a message field and Send
Enter in the message field or on Send sends to the picked people and announces it
Enter or Space on Copy link copies it and announces 'Link copied'
